14. What are the common causes of kidney stone formation?
Kidney stones (renal lithiasis or nephrolithiasis) form as a 
result of abnormal crystallization of calcium, oxalate, stru-
vite, cystine, hydroxyapatite, or uric acid that is unable to be 
excreted normally in the urine.
